items.rationale: The selected Glass Breakage Cover includes drilling needed to fit the pane hardware (sections 1.3 and 2.7.2). The gross estimate for one mounting hole is €20.

items.description: Fit replacement pane into existing frame
items.rationale: Section 2.7.2 covers fitting the replacement glass. The gross estimate is €48 for one installation in the existing frame, excluding the separately billed drilling and travel.

Sections 2.7.1 and 2.7.2 cover the cracked cabinet pane and its made-to-measure replacement. The gross estimate is €80 for one pane matching the original specification, with no allowance for an upgrade under section 7.1.10.
Sections 2.7.2 and 7.1.12 cover one attendance at which insured work was performed. The gross estimate is €25 for the single visit, with no apportionment or assumed deductible.
